# Pi (agent runtime)

ATLAS embeds the Pi SDK as a dependency. ATLAS is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Pi project; "Pi" names belong to their owners.

| Package | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent | 0.87.1 | MIT | https://github.com/earendil-works/pi @ f07218c4d4bbc12bef056a7058c3dd49dfe41abe |
| @earendil-works/pi-agent-core | 0.87.1 | MIT | same repository |
| @earendil-works/pi-ai | 0.87.1 | MIT | same repository |

The published npm tarballs declare `"license": "MIT"` but do not include a LICENSE file. [`pi-LICENSE.txt`](pi-LICENSE.txt) is the LICENSE file from the upstream repository at the pinned commit (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/earendil-works/pi/f07218c4d4bbc12bef056a7058c3dd49dfe41abe/LICENSE`). It is shipped with the packaged app.

`pnpm pi:version` verifies the installed versions and license fields against this pin.
